purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, current viewer configuration, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Official ATR/BPN evidence establishes Kantor Pertanahan Kota Bengkulu as the city custodian. BHUMI is the national public map viewer and its current JavaScript names a Geoserver parcel layer (`umum:Persil`) and an internal `/expapi/getPersil` path. No anonymous safe ID-plus-complete-polygon response was obtained.
registryAssessment: Local city registry custody found through the official ATR/BPN Kota Bengkulu site. National agency documentation separately confirms BHUMI as the public land-map channel; this is not treated as proof of citywide geometry availability.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official city office page names Kantor Pertanahan Kota Bengkulu and discusses its land-use/land administration role.
Official BHUMI documentation describes the interactive ATR/BPN spatial map and its integration with the ATLAS geospatial platform.
Official guidance states that publicly accessible land-map information is served through BHUMI.
